To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the gamma subunit is essential for processive DNA synthesis and that the gamma subunits are present as a tight complex with the other subunits.

DNA polymerase III of E. coli is composed of 11 subunits, that the holoenzyme is a complex of three subassemblies, and that a complex containing the gamma, delta, delta', chi, and psi subunits is essential for processive DNA synthesis.
a novel auxiliary protein complex is required for processive DNA synthesis and that the gamma subunit is essential for the complex to form.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the mechanism of DNA replication in E. coli, a model system for studying the process of DNA replication in all organisms.
the structure of DNA polymerase holoenzyme of E. coli.
the structure and function of a complex, DNA polymerase III, that catalyzes the synthesis of DNA in the Escherichia coil cell.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the DNA polymerase III core (alpha epsilon theta) is the catalytic subunit, that the beta subunit is the processivity factor, and that the gamma and delta subunits, as well as the delta' and chi subunits of the gamma auxiliary complex, are essential for processivity.
the pol III holoenzyme is composed of the alpha, epsilon, and beta subunits and that the gamma subunit is an essential auxiliary component.
the gamma subunit of pol III holoenzyme is an essential component of a complex that restores processivity to the pol III core.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the gamma subunit is an essential component of the DNA polymerase III auxiliary complex, that the delta subunit is an accessory component, and that the delta' and psi subunits are required for maximal activity.

the holoenzyme of DNA polymerase is an alpha epsilon theta beta gamma delta delta' chi psi complex, and that the auxiliary tau polypeptide, although not essential for processive DNA synthesis, is required for maximal activity.

the pol III holoenzyme is a complex of five subassemblies (alpha, epsilon and theta; tau; beta; and the gamma/delta/chi/psi complex) and that each subassembly has an essential role in the processive synthesis of DNA by pol III.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the auxiliary complex is a novel component of DNA polymerase holoenzyme.
the gamma complex, not the tau complex, restores processivity to the pol III core.
the auxiliary subunits of pol III holoenzyme are not just structural components that stabilize the enzyme but are also essential for its function.
